key.name: provider
key.description: Which CodexBar provider's plan limits to show, e.g. claude, codex, gemini, cursor. See `codexbar usage --help` for the full list.

key.name: codexbar-path
key.description: Leave empty to search PATH and the usual install locations.

key.name: ccusage-path
key.description: Leave empty to search PATH, ~/.local/bin, bun, volta and nvm.

key.name: panel-style
key.description: icon: the brain plus a small meter of plan headroom left. percent: also the % left. full: also today's token count.
